card.line: Geruth Chimham was a place near Bethlehem where survivors from Judah stopped, afraid of Babylon, before planning to flee to Egypt.

moments.title: Stopping before Egypt
moments.text: Johanan and the commanders led the remnant of the people to Geruth Chimham, near Bethlehem. They planned to go on to Egypt to escape the Chaldeans, because they were afraid after Gedaliah was killed.

moments.title: Asking Jeremiah to pray
moments.text: The commanders and all the people asked Jeremiah to pray for them and ask the LORD what to do. They promised to act on every word the LORD sent, and Jeremiah said he would hold nothing back.
